name: closure_tolerance_20260805
authorized_by: project owner, explicit delegation after options and costs were presented
comparability: anything compared across this change is a new declared experiment

reasons: the trainer restores RNG state from the checkpoint and the visual bank is a fixed 50x5 selection with per-position seeds, so resuming from best.pt re-runs identical epochs and re-hits the identical failure - an infinite loop
resuming from the failing last.pt is forbidden: it is an artifact quarantined by an invariant failure
why_no_workaround.consequence: a 20-epoch run had roughly a coin-flip chance of dying with no legitimate recovery path

defect.nature_of_residual: float32 reduction error over thousands of cells; a few units in the last place of the magnitude summed, therefore scaling with it
defect.breaking_point: at 300 GeV one float32 ULP is 3.05e-5 GeV, already exceeding the whole 2e-5 tolerance

measurement.conclusion: the residual is ULP-quantized: bounded and small in ULP, varying 100x in absolute terms

closure_tolerance_gev.note: still binds below the 2 GeV crossover

change.backward_compatibility: the 0.0 default means every config frozen before 2026-08-05 keeps the exact absolute-only rule and its accepted runs stay reproducible
change.declared_by: scripts/build_final_continuation.py, only for configs it generates from 2026-08-05

why_1e_minus_5.margin_below_a_real_defect: a single mis-decoded cell shifts a layer budget by of order the cell energy, ~0.05 GeV at 33 GeV = 1.5e-3 relative, roughly 150x above the tolerance
why_1e_minus_5.assessment: admits float32 noise without admitting a defect; the ~150x gap between regimes means the choice is not delicate

empirical_validation.method: replay all 100 measured rows under the new rule

defect_found_during_implementation.bug: max(absolute, relative * scale) applied unconditionally raises a deliberately negative tolerance to 0.0 when relative is 0.0
defect_found_during_implementation.symptom: tests/test_epoch_visualization.py::test_epoch_visualization_writes_evidence_when_invariants_fail reported DID NOT RAISE, because it forces failure by setting closure_tolerance_gev = -1.0 and an exact-zero residual then passed
defect_found_during_implementation.fix: the relative branch participates only when relative > 0.0
defect_found_during_implementation.note: exactly the failure mode AGENTS.md 23 exists to catch - a change that made a guard stop guarding. Caught by the suite, not by inspection.

single_reader: closure_tolerances(config) serves all five gates so they cannot drift apart

gates_sharing_the_tolerance.asymmetry_unchanged: the 7-draw gate can still pass while the 250-draw export fails

boundary.p10_epoch_40: remains ARTIFACT QUARANTINED; it was quarantined under the old rule and re-auditing it under the new one is a separate declared act that has not been performed. It is not a valid parent.
